demos.title: Deterministic scenario explorer
demos.summary: Deterministic control: runs repeated identical deterministic paths of the reviewed public scenario. This is NOT Monte Carlo and carries no statistical uncertainty evidence; it serves as the zero-variance negative control for the stochastic flagship demo.
demos.boundary: This deterministic scenario explorer demonstrates model wiring and comparative UX only. Its repeated paths are identical by construction: zero dispersion is a property of the deterministic controllers, not statistical evidence. It is not Monte Carlo, is uncalibrated, and is not investment, launch, legal, financial, forecast, or decision-grade advice.

controls.label: Ending transaction value

controls.label: Holding time
controls.description: Constant illustrative holding-time assumption used by the public scenario.

presets.label: Downside

presets.label: Upside
presets.summary: Higher adoption and transaction value with longer holding time.

demos.title: Stochastic growth — Monte Carlo uncertainty
demos.summary: Flagship stochastic demo: the reviewed public economy with three approved, illustrative, independent per-path priors executed by the real Monte Carlo runner with seeded reproducibility, outcome intervals, estimator confidence intervals, sensitivity, and convergence evidence.
demos.boundary: This Monte Carlo demo samples three illustrative, uncalibrated, explicitly independent priors derived from the reviewed public presets. Modeled outcome intervals (P10-P90) are cross-path spreads of simulated outcomes, not confidence intervals and not forecasts. It is not investment, launch, legal, financial, forecast, or decision-grade advice.
